name: Seed Stock
summary: Secure Bloom samples in a quarantined district for Vesper Somatics.
situation: The unit is assigned to secure Bloom samples in a quarantined district.

spine.title: Deliberate seeding
spine.goal: Discover that Vesper is seeding the Bloom deliberately.

spine.title: Engineered defect
spine.goal: A squad member's defect is revealed to be engineered.

spine.title: The choice
spine.goal: Deliver the evidence to Vesper, sell it to Aurum, or bury it.

spine.title: Consequences
spine.goal: Live with the consequences of the choice.

name: Quota
summary: Clear a mining corridor overrun by mutants before a Kestrel-Ward shareholder deadline.
situation: The unit must clear a mining corridor overrun by mutants before a shareholder deadline.

spine.title: Acceptable loss
spine.goal: Find survivors Kestrel listed as "acceptable loss".

spine.title: Rival team
spine.goal: A rival Sable team arrives with different orders.

spine.title: The choice
spine.goal: Choose between the quota, the survivors, or the rival team's offer.

spine.title: Consequences
spine.goal: Live with the consequences of the choice.
